title: Out-of-State Lapse Notice Days for Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) Certificates
content:
**Rule.** On a lapse SR-26 under Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44), sent for a certificate whose backing term was cancelled and has since been reinstated with a lapse, lapse out-of-state notice days are added to the lapse run-off. They depend on two things: whether the certificate's filing state differs from the backing term's own state, and whether the two states lie in the same state group.

- **Backing term's own state.** For a Named Non-Owner Policy term it is the resident state on the term. For an Owner Auto Policy term it is the garaging state.
- **State groups.** Florida and Virginia; Texas and Georgia; Arizona and Ohio.

| Filing state compared with the backing term's own state | Days added |
|---|---|
| in a different state group | 3 days |
| a different state in the same state group | 1 day |
| the same state | no days |

**Matrix of hypothetical pairs**

| Backing term's own state | Filing state | Days added |
|---|---|---|
| Florida | Virginia | 1 |
| Florida | Texas | 3 |
| Georgia | Georgia | 0 |
| Arizona | Ohio | 1 |
| Ohio | Florida | 3 |
